tra_loi.Q1: The British hold it. A Union Jack flies over the tower on the hillside in frames 40-41, which show the main part of the video (1779-1781). Earlier frames show the town changing hands over the centuries, but the pictures don't say who held it then.
tra_loi.Q2: The Great Siege. Frame 23 shows an on-screen caption reading '1779 — The Great Siege', and after it the dates run through 1779 with camps of tents and a trench line being built on the land side.
tra_loi.Q3: Not sure. The pictures don't show hunger or starvation directly. The town is surrounded by land camps and trenches, and ships sit offshore, so the likely cause is a blockade, but nothing shows food shortages.
tra_loi.Q4: A fleet of many ships. In frames 47 and 53-56 (Jan 1780 and Apr 1781) a large group of sailing ships approaches the town from the sea, which looks like a relief fleet. It is not clear whether they are friendly or enemy, and no text confirms it.

tra_loi.Q1: The British. A Union Jack flies on the tower of the fortified town in frames 40-41 (Jan 1780). Nothing on screen names the nation, but the flag is the only evidence of who holds it.
tra_loi.Q2: A siege. Frame 23 shows the title card '1779 — The Great Siege' (21 Jun 1779). Over the following frames, camps of rows of tents and a trench or earthworks line appear on the land side of the rock (frames 28-33), and ships gather in the bay.
tra_loi.Q3: Not clearly shown. The pictures suggest the town is cut off. Enemy camps and trenches sit on the land side, and ships sit offshore, which looks like a blockade by land and sea. The ships are not shown to be cutting off supplies, and no scene shows hunger or empty stores. Frames 48-49 show people near what look like barrels or crates by the wall, which might be food or supplies, but I'm not sure.
tra_loi.Q4: Ships, probably a relief fleet. A large group of many sailing ships approaches the town from the sea (frames 47 and 53-56, Jan 1780 and Apr 1781), and a few ships arrive in frame 51. Nothing on screen says whose ships they are or that they carry food, so this is an inference. Frames 57-58 show glowing, burning shapes at night.
